t: The free open source desktop editor for writing and uploading Arduino sketches.
steps: Download the IDE from the Arduino software page.
Ask IT to install it on lab machines.
Install board packages and libraries while online.
Preinstall those packages for any offline lab.
Connect a board by USB and upload a blink sketch.
Set no_proxy=localhost before launch if the IDE hangs at startup on a lab computer with no internet.
Use the Cloud Editor or Cloud app on Chromebooks.
